# DeKalb

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - DeKalb!

At our DeKalb physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized treatment from an expert clinician.

Located on Hillcrest Dr. right along the Kishwaukee River, we go out of our way to make your physical rehabilitation and recovery a great experience. We have been providing the highest quality physical therapy in DeKalb county for over 25 years, first as **Creative Therapeutics** and now as DPT! We offer [pelvic floor physical therapy](https://doctorsofphysicaltherapy.com/our-services/pelvic-floor-therapy/) and women’s health services in addition to expert orthopedic care.

No prescription? No problem! Direct Access means you get to choose where you go for treatment. We’ll work closely with you and your physician to develop an individualized treatment plan that works for you in your life. We can even refer you to a great physician, if needed.

We will do everything in our power to accommodate your busy schedule. All of our locations have flexible hours to help you get the physical therapy you need, when you need it. We’re here to help you get better, faster!

Our friendly staff is happy to walk you through necessary paperwork and assist in any way possible, including insurance questions and scheduling. We’ll even call your insurance company for you to help you understand your benefits.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

400 E. Hillcrest Dr.

Suite 110

DeKalb, IL 60115

### Get In touch

Phone: 815-758-5508

Fax: 815-758-5537

### Clinic Hours

Mon: 7am- 7pm

Tues: 7:30am- 5:30pm

Wed: 7am- 5:30pm

Thurs: 8:30am- 5:30pm

Fri: 7:30am- 3:30pm

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed
